D: An American soldier goes absent without leave to fight in a secret, brutal martial arts tournament in Hong Kong.
P: Serve the snacks when Frank lands in Hong Kong and meets Ray.
S: Puffy bubble waffles made from custard batter, crisp outside
Batter of flour, eggs, sugar, evaporated milk and a little custard powder, cooked in an egg waffle pan until crisp outside, soft inside.
Kowloon Walled City curry fish balls
Fish balls simmered in coconut curry sauce and served on skewers

Fish balls simmered in a curry sauce of curry powder, garlic, coconut milk and a little sugar, served on skewers. Fry 2 tbsp curry powder and crushed garlic in oil for a minute. Add 400ml coconut milk, a spoon of sugar and a little water and simmer 5 minutes. Add 500g fish balls and simmer for 10 minutes until hot through. Thread onto skewers and spoon over the sauce.
fluffy steamed buns with diced roast pork in sticky oyster and hoisin sauce, split on top

Fluffy steamed buns filled with diced char siu pork in a sticky oyster, hoisin and sugar sauce, steamed until puffed and split open on top. Dice 300g char siu pork. Fry a diced shallot, add 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp hoisin, 1 tbsp sugar and 100ml water, thicken with 1 tsp cornflour and stir in the pork. Cool. Mix 300g bao flour, 5g dried yeast, 30g sugar and 160ml warm water into a soft dough, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Divide into 12, fill, pinch closed and prove 20 minutes. Steam 12 minutes.
M: pork and prawn dumplings in clear ginger broth, egg strands, choy sum, a bowl between bouts

Pork and prawn wontons in a clear chicken, ginger and dried shrimp broth with thin egg noodles, blanched choy sum and a drizzle of sesame oil. Simmer 1.5L chicken stock with 4 slices ginger and 1 tbsp dried shrimp for 20 minutes, then season with soy and white pepper. Mix 200g pork mince, 200g chopped green prawns, sesame oil and soy, and fold into 24 wonton wrappers. Boil the wontons for 3 minutes. Cook 300g thin egg noodles for 1 minute and blanch 2 bunches choy sum. Divide into bowls, top with wontons and pour over the hot broth.
Wok-fried rump steak with onion and peppers in black pepper oyster sauce

Rump steak strips marinated in soy and cornflour, stir-fried hard with onion, capsicum and garlic, finished with lots of cracked black pepper and oyster sauce, over steamed rice. Slice 600g rump steak thinly and marinate in soy and a spoon of cornflour for 20 minutes. Stir-fry hard in a very hot wok, then add sliced onion, green capsicum and garlic. Finish with oyster sauce and a big spoon of cracked black pepper. Serve over jasmine rice.
W: Puff pastry tarts filled with silky baked egg custard

Puff pastry pressed into tart tins, filled with a custard of eggs, milk, evaporated milk and sugar strained until silky, baked at 200C for 15 minutes until just set and wobbly. Cut puff pastry into rounds and press into a patty tin. Whisk 3 eggs with 150ml milk, 100ml evaporated milk and 80g sugar until dissolved, then strain until silky. Fill the cases and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until just set and still wobbly in the centre.
K: Very strong black tea with evaporated milk and sugar, hot or over ice
Strong black tea simmered 5 minutes, strained through a fine cloth, mixed with evaporated milk and sugar, served hot or over ice.

dishes.make_ahead: Whisk the batter up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; cook the waffles just before serving as they go soft quickly

steps.text: Whisk the flour, custard powder, baking powder and sugar.
Add the eggs, evaporated milk and water and whisk smooth.
Rest the batter for 30 minutes.
Cook in a hot egg waffle pan brushed with the oil, 3 minutes a side, in batches until crisp and golden.

Fry the curry powder and garlic in oil.
Add the coconut milk, sugar and water and simmer.
Add the fish balls and simmer until hot through.

Fry the curry powder and garlic in oil.

dishes.make_ahead: Slice the steak, onion, capsicum and garlic and marinate the steak in the soy and cornflour up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cook the rice and stir-fry on the night

steps.text: Slice the steak thinly and slice the onion, capsicum and garlic.
Marinate the steak in soy and cornflour.
Cook the rice.
Heat the oil in a very hot wok and stir-fry the beef hard.
Add the onion, capsicum and garlic.
Finish with oyster sauce and cracked black pepper and serve over the rice.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the tofu, onion, capsicum and garlic up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; coat and fry the tofu and cook the rice on the night

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2cm cubes. Slice the onion, capsicum and garlic.
Toss the tofu in the soy, then in the cornflour.
Cook the rice.
Fry the tofu in the oil in a very hot wok until crisp, then lift out.
Stir-fry the onion, capsicum and garlic in the same wok.
Return the tofu, finish with the mushroom oyster sauce and cracked black pepper and serve over the rice.

dishes.make_ahead: Line the tins and make the custard up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; strain, fill and bake on the night, best eaten warm

steps.text: Cut the pastry into rounds and press into a patty tin.
Whisk the eggs, milk, evaporated milk and sugar until dissolved.
Strain until silky and fill the cases.
Bake at 200C until just set with a wobble in the centre.
Cool a little before serving.

dishes.make_ahead: Brew the strong tea up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; stir in the evaporated milk and sugar to serve hot or over ice

steps.text: Simmer the tea bags in water until very strong.
Strain through a fine cloth or sieve into a jug.
Stir in the evaporated milk and sugar to taste.
Serve hot in cups, or chill and pour over ice.
